title: Particular Plants
description: A mod that only allows plants to be placed in biomes they spawn in
body:
## About
A mod to encourage the exploration of worlds by restricting the places where plants can grow and be placed.

## Features
Restricts placement/growth of plants to only biomes where 
they generate in. (i.e Acacia sapling -> Savana biome)
Currently supports:
- Saplings
- Bamboo
- Crops

## Details
The mod was designed to be as generic as possible so most biome and world generation mods should work correctly.

The Crop option should remain false unless you have another mod that add crop features like wild crops.

Items are still consumed when a placement or growth fails.

Configurable in config file via 
- noPlace : true (restricts placement)
- noGrow : true (restricts growing)
- noCrops : true (restricts crop placement)
